name: po-claude-toolkit
description: Product Owner toolkit for Obsidian + Claude Code: git-like sync between an Obsidian vault and Confluence, plus creation of pages, folders and whole project trees, with Jira links, PlantUML and user mentions support. Also a morning routine that builds the daily note from the calendar, tasks, Gmail and Jira.

plugins.name: confluence-sync
plugins.description: Four risk-separated skills for git-like Confluence sync from an Obsidian vault: status (read-only), link, pull, push. Paste a Confluence URL to link a note or folder, search pages by title, detect conflicts before they bite, and scaffold a whole project tree from a template.

plugins.name: daily-note
plugins.description: Morning routine for an Obsidian vault: /daily-note:start-my-day builds today's daily note with a Summary paragraph, an Alert list of Confluence pages that moved, and one heading per meeting from Google Calendar, then opens it with Advanced URI.
